focal_domain: refrigeration, with refrigerator compressor as intended external application
public_test_access: sealed until candidate decisions are frozen; no feature fitting, alignment, pseudo-label generation, calibration or threshold tuning on test
prior_validation_status: known development evidence, never reported as a new independent test
new_source_evidence: license, identity, measured versus simulated origin and independent label meaning verified before use

development_roles.parent_train: grouped model/bridge fitting and nested selection
development_roles.parent_validation: known-domain diagnostic and exploratory comparison; previously inspected
development_roles.new_sources: reserve groups and independent references before learned exploration
development_roles.calibration: group-held-out public reference predictions; never pseudo-label agreement
development_roles.transductive: only a predeclared public unlabeled adaptation subset; never local readings

hypotheses.question: Which vibration and electrical feature families distinguish SMART reference states across public development groups?
hypotheses.role: diagnostic anchor, not a source-only final substitute

hypotheses.question: Do band-aware spectral and temporal representations improve shared mechanical signatures beyond three shape moments?
Can actual electrical/operating variables link SMART to labelled refrigeration fault experiments?
hypotheses.role: candidate cross-source anchor, verify variables first

hypotheses.question: Can genuine paired RWTH modalities predict or reconstruct a thermal/vibration relation beyond operating-regime baselines?
hypotheses.role: measured public bridge, no arbitrary binary labels

hypotheses.question: Can references from public refrigeration fault experiments independently evaluate a transferred relation or add compatible labelled examples?
Can ULT thermal dynamics and uncertain service-event timing support episode-level linkage without inventing minute-level truth?
hypotheses.role: thermal bridge and uncertain event reference

hypotheses.question: Which additional measured refrigeration datasets close a missing shared variable or independent fault reference?
hypotheses.role: targeted search after an identified gap, renewable by cycle

hypotheses.question: Which candidate summaries remain useful under public-only sampling and bandwidth stress tests compatible with sparse acquisition hypotheses?
hypotheses.role: application representation research; no local-value fitting

comparisons: reference plus independently admissible derived labels

label_policy.transfer_acceptance: independent target reference or documented physically justified evidence; uncertain cases abstain
label_policy.soft_labels: retain as evidence; explicit hard-label/weight policy before RandomForestClassifier fitting
label_policy.scope: provider reference state unless compressor-specific fault evidence is available

initial_model_space.selection: grouped public development only; changes require a new protocol revision

probability_policy.calibrated_score: estimated provider-reference probability, with calibration/domain support status
methods_to_compare: sigmoid from held-out-group public reference scores
probability_policy.physical_failure_probability: not claimed without corresponding target and independent validation

prototype_public_acceptance.average_precision: above the constant-prevalence baseline; report class support and group uncertainty
prototype_public_acceptance.probability_quality: compare Brier/log loss to constant prior and reliability by support; insufficient calibration support stays explicit
prototype_public_acceptance.rationale: research prototype targets above balanced chance, useful detection and bounded false alerts; no 100 percent accuracy requirement or safety/reliability claim
prototype_public_acceptance.insufficient_support_result: inconclusive, continue source/hypothesis work rather than force a success or a general impossibility claim

continuation: failed path creates the next hypothesis/source search; preserve all results and sealed references; do not fabricate data, correlation or labels to finish

initial_acquisition_budgets.larger_input: document necessity and increase the next acquisition plan explicitly
